messages:
Sam: Heads-up: planning a rolling reboot window in az2 tonight 00:30-03:30 UTC to apply NIC hotfix and kernel micropatch. We'll do staggered node drains to avoid >10% capacity loss per pool. Notifying on-call and customers.
Priya: ACK. Which pools exactly and any priority tenant exclusions?
Sam: Targeting gpu-pool-az2-{a,b,c} (approx 500 GPUs). Plan: drain cohorts of ~10 nodes, backfill from az1/az3 where possible, allow 15m warmup between cohorts. Keep preemptible mix as-is.
Mateo: Need to protect Dedicated customers — recommend excluding their nodes from drains and reserving backfill capacity.
Jin: Agreed. We'll mark dedicated nodes with label and change the scheduler exclude flag. Also want KV cache preheat before we route traffic.
Sam: Will exclude dedicated nodes by label: dedicated=true. Drain command we're using: 
```bash
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```
And preheat KV cache: 
```bash
python ops/preheat_kvcache.py --pool gpu-pool-az2-a --minutes 20
```
Priya: Any expected SLO impact / latency spikes we should warn customers about?
Sam: Expect a 95th percentile latency bump of ~30-60ms for 15-30m for some routes during cohort handoffs. We'll route low-priority inference to az3 if it spikes.
Ops-Bot: Scheduled window created: 2025-11-05T00:30Z -> 2025-11-05T03:30Z. Notifications set to #customer-updates and PagerDuty.
Mateo: Cost tradeoff: cross-region backfill may increase egress for long-running training jobs. Suggest we only backfill short-lived jobs and advertise a pause for large training runs.
Sam: Good call. We'll add scheduler flag: max_job_runtime_for_backfill=15m and email tenants with >10% GPU share asking them to checkpoint/avoid long jobs during the window.
Jin: Rollback plan: if node doesn’t come up after reboot, escalate to firmware team and fail traffic to az1. Also snapshot /var/lib/modelcache on each node before drain.
Priya: I'll draft the customer advisory and post to #customer-updates + send scheduled email.
Sam: Oncall: @Alex primary during window, @Priya backup. Post-mortem owner: Mateo. :thumbsup:
Alex: Oncall ACK — I'll be online 00:20-03:45 UTC and will monitor queue and pager.
Sam: I'll run a preflight at 23:45 UTC to validate drain scripts and a smoke test at 00:15 for KV preheat. Any other blockers?
Mateo: None here. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ops/runbooks/az2-reboot-2025
